params.body: Staging has 79,464 photos with derived sizes; one process does one or two a second (S3 read, resize, S3 write, two files per photo), a day in total. --shard=i/n takes only photos with id % n = i, so n copies run side by side on disjoint sets, e.g. nohup ... --shard=0/4 through --shard=3/4.
params.title: fotos-afgeleid: --shard to run copies side by side
